p: Use Hanzo AI models inside Cursor IDE by adding a custom API provider. Access Zen, GPT-4.1, Claude Sonnet, and 50+ other models directly in your editor.
API Key: Get yours at platform.hanzo.ai/api-keys · Fully OpenAI-compatible · every model on the gateway available
License: Proprietary · View source on GitHub →
Hanzo AI is OpenAI-compatible, so existing Cursor code works with zero refactoring. We deeply appreciate the Anysphere team for building and maintaining this open-source project.

code: // Settings > Models > Add custom model { " provider " : " openai-compatible " , " name " : " Hanzo AI " , " baseUrl " : " https://api.hanzo.ai/v1 " , " apiKey " : " your-hanzo-api-key " , " models " : [ " zen4-pro " , " zen4-max " , " openai/gpt-4.1 " , " anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6 " ] }
# Query Hanzo models list curl https://api.hanzo.ai/v1/models \ -H " Authorization: Bearer $ HANZO_API_KEY " | jq ' .data[].id '

curl https://api.hanzo.ai/v1/chat/completions \ -H " Authorization: Bearer $ HANZO_API_KEY " \ -H " Content-Type: application/json " \ -d ' {"model":"zen4-pro","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hello from Cursor!"}],"max_tokens":50} '
# zen4-pro: best for code generation # zen4-coder: specialized code model # zen4-thinking: step-by-step reasoning # openai/gpt-4.1: advanced reasoning # All available at api.hanzo.ai/v1

p: Create a free account and get your API key. The Free plan includes free model requests and Kai decisions, no card.
